answer: Trellis scheduling. Identity slots are earned by answering randomized, time-locked micro-tasks whose only value is proving continuous presence; scheduling reserves each slot in a public trellis for a fixed window. An attacker must staff every claimed identity through those windows, paying parallel human attention cost rather than one-time registration. Rewards flow only to slots that collect nectar from three independent peers. What matters is the orchard can verify each slot's sustained labor.
